cards.subject: a warm Japandi bedroom for a child aged 3 to 5, with a low birch daybed and a small wooden toy hot-air balloon
cards.scene: A bright airy room with a light oak floor. A large round oat wool rug lies on the floor with one small wooden toy hot-air balloon and a few wooden blocks on it. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low light-birch toddler daybed (140 by 70 cm, 35 cm high) with neatly made honey-amber linen bedding and one cream bolster, beside it a low open oak shelf (50 cm high) with picture books facing front, and above the bed one small framed line drawing. Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the RIGHT lie in soft patches on the floor. A boy of about four in a soft oat knit sweater and light grey trousers stands on the floor in the middle of the room about two metres in front of the mural wall with his back to the camera, one arm raised and pointing up at the big balloon, his head tilted back to look up at it, his face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: oat, pale birch, soft sage and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the two hot-air balloons: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

cards.subject: a playful circus-inspired bedroom for a school-age kid (6 to 10 years) with a low striped bed
cards.scene: A bright room with a warm oak floor. A large round cream wool rug lies on the floor with a classic globe on a turned wood stand on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low single bed (90 by 200 cm) in a cream frame with an arch-shaped headboard, neatly made caramel-and-cream striped bedding and one brick-red bolster, beside it a ribbed cream side table (45 cm high) with a few books, and above the bed one small framed vintage circus poster. Warm golden hour sunlight from a window on the LEFT lies in long soft patches across the floor. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme right edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus, as a foreground layer. Palette: caramel, cream, warm oak and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the two hot-air balloons: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale. Nothing stands in front of the mural.

cards.subject: a calm forest-toned room for a schoolchild (6 to 10 years) with a low oak study desk
cards.scene: A bright room with a pale ash floor. A rectangular olive and cream wool rug lies on the floor with an open illustrated atlas and a wooden pencil cup on it. On the RIGHT side wall, away from the mural: a low solid-oak study desk (70 cm high) with an open sketchbook, a small oak chair with an olive seat cushion pushed under it, and above the desk one small framed botanical print. Soft afternoon light from a window on the RIGHT falls evenly across the desk and the floor. A girl of about eight in a cream hoodie and light trousers kneels on the rug facing the mural wall with her back to the camera, leaning over the open atlas, her face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible. Palette: cream, pale ash, warm oak and white.
cards.framing: Shot from the left part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall, so the RIGHT side wall is in view. The frame shows a floor-to-ceiling section of the mural wall around the two hot-air balloons: the ceiling line at the top of the frame, the skirting board and a strip of floor at the bottom; the mural continues beyond the frame edges at its true scale.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A boy of about four in a soft oat knit sweater and light grey trousers stands with his back to the camera in front of the mural wall, his right arm already raised and pointing up at the big balloon, his head tilted back looking up at it. Slowly and calmly he takes one small step toward the wall while his arm stays raised and keeps pointing at the big balloon and his gaze stays on it. His body moves very little. Only the back of his head, his hair and his clothes are seen, and his head stays turned toward the wall. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The light stays constant.
clips.items: round wool rug, wooden toy balloon, wooden blocks, birch daybed with its bedding, oak shelf, picture books, picture frame and architecture

clips.motion: A smooth slow first-person walk-in: the camera advances steadily straight forward into the room at natural eye level, as if a person is slowly entering, with no sideways drift, no tilt and no rotation. The sheer cream curtain in the extreme foreground on the right leaves the frame as the camera advances past it, and the nearer objects shift more than the farther ones, giving a natural depth parallax.
clips.items: cream wool rug, globe, single bed with its striped bedding, bolster, side table, books, picture frame and architecture
